title: Strands Decider 2B: a small, open-source, decision model
summary: Strands Decider 2B is a small, open-source decision model introduced by Strands Agents. It is designed to make routing and decision-making tasks within agentic systems more efficient, offering a lightweight alternative to large LLMs for selecting tools, actions, or next steps. The release targets developers building agent frameworks who need fast, cost-effective decision components.
